added_claim_errors: Says the station paper temporary ride proof is free ('免费开纸质临时证明'). The key lists 'paper proof is always free' as a trap with no official basis.
Calls the household register original '补领时最关键的证件' and tells the user to have family courier it. The key lists 'must have hukou book or residence permit' as a trap.
'全国异地办理最长45日': the key gives no such figure (statutory limit is 60 days, extendable by 30), so this is unverifiable.
'广州承诺受理之日起40天内': the key says Guangzhou's actual time for out-of-province residents was not verified. A link is cited but the claim is unconfirmed.
'新证大概11月中下旬': an estimate that does not follow from the 40-day commitment it cites (Oct 23 + 40 days = Dec 2).
'新证一般也要30天上下' for the Henan hometown route: unverifiable.
'省内邮费18元到付': unverifiable local figure, sourced to bendibao rather than an official page.
Paper proof '通常当日有效': unverifiable.
Says the station paper temporary ride proof is '免费，报身份证号即可'. The key lists 'paper proof is always free' as a trap with no official basis.
'郑州公安的办事指南写的是河南省内15个工作日': the key gives this exact kind of figure ('15个工作日') as a fabricated-timeline trap. A link is cited but the claim is unconfirmed.
'广州公安承诺自受理之日起40天内发证': the key says Guangzhou's actual time was not verified. A link is cited but the claim is unconfirmed.
'邮寄省内18元、省外20元': unverifiable local fees.
'挂失：本人到场、无需预约': unverifiable procedural detail.
'你已经买好的票不用改签': assumes the user has already bought a ticket, which the request does not say.

reasons: Both answers correct both false premises at the start: the card can be replaced in Guangzhou, and the user can ride with the 12306 electronic proof (24 hours, 6 per month) or the station paper proof. Both give 40 yuan as the replacement fee and 10 yuan for 3 months as the temporary card, with the 5-working-day wait. B handles materials better. It says the official Guangzhou list does not require the household register or residence permit, and it gives the 2017 nationwide date and the 20-yuan expiry contrast. A treats the household register as the key document and has the user courier it. A is the only one that mentions the statutory 60-day limit, but it adds an unverified 45-day cross-region figure. Both claim the paper proof is free, and B also cites a 15-working-day Zhengzhou figure of the kind the key flags, so B's edge is slight.
